definitions.gloss: what floor; which floor; how many floors
definitions.explanation: An interrogative used to ask which story of a building something is on, or how many stories a building has.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何階|なんかい}です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What floor is the sales area on?

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何階|なんかい}{建|だ}てです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many stories is this building?

examples.japanese: ⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会議室|かいぎしつ}→会議室：01265_kaigishitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{何階|なんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{尋|たず}ねた→尋ねる：01175_tazuneru⟧。
examples.english: At the reception I asked what floor the meeting room was on.

notes:
⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧ (what, how many) + ⟦{階|かい}→階：01034_kai⟧ (floor, story). Distinct from the homophone ⟦{何回|なんかい}→何回：08497_nankai⟧ ('how many times'), which uses ⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧ (occasions).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {何階|なんかい}です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: What floor is it?
- {何階|なんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: on what floor is it?
- {何階|なんかい}{建|だ}て: how many stories (tall)
- {何階|なんかい}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: up to what floor

DISAMBIGUATION:
In speech, {何階|なんかい} (what floor) and ⟦{何回|なんかい}→何回：08497_nankai⟧ (how many times) sound identical. Context usually resolves the ambiguity, but speakers sometimes clarify by saying {何階目|なんかいめ} ('which floor') vs. ⟦{何回目|なんかいめ}→何回目：30343_nankaime⟧ ('which time').

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{一階|いっかい}→一階：27512_ikkai⟧: first floor
- ⟦{二階|にかい}→二階：27513_nikai⟧: second floor
- ⟦{三階|さんがい}→三階：27617_sangai⟧: third floor
- ⟦{地下|ちか}→地下：03429_chika⟧{何階|なんかい}: which basement level
